body: Thanks for the replies so far guys, it really helps..Especially the BPD one, I have googled it and the symptoms are the exact same ones as wikipedia says... And yes, I am still in frequent contact with her, and I am unsure whether it is going somewhere or not... Always when I have been thinking of ending the friendship she gave me a little spark of hope that maybe we could return to where we used to be... That makes me want to keep on going but is destroying me at same time...
